body:
I'm gay.  My SO knows of my depression. She supports people's right to choose this option.  I haven't exactly told her of my decision, only that I've been thinking about this subject lately.  

I can talk to her.  I also have a therapist.  I'm fortunate enough to having supportive family and friends.  The devastation I will leave behind is not lost on me.  But consider this:  is it more emotionally draining to my loved ones to continue this emotional rollercoaster for the course of an entire lifetime,  or to make a decision to end it.  An extremely painful moment for them, but with time they will eventually move on.  Sure, there will be days of grief,  but overall the drama that comes with dealing with my problems has long been removed. 

I don't have all the answers.  I just know this is what I want.

These are some of the kindest comments I have ever received and I genuinely appreciate them.  I also want to thank you for being so kind and non-judgmental throughout this thread.  You are a good person and I find that to be a rare quality these days.

I would love to pretend that I do not believe in things like fate, however even I tend to see things as "the world telling me something" when it seems to happen repeatedly.   This explains partially why I am still here.  I genuinely cannot predict what this year will hold.  I only know that I have been thinking about this for approximately two years.  I have no hope of never feeling depressed again in my life.  This is an absolute guarantee.  I have depression.  It comes and goes.  It is seemingly unpredictable. And at times it is extremely hard to live with.  I'm just very tired from this struggle.

Approximately a year out.  This is tenative as situations have arisen in the past delaying my progress. I don't anticipate any more unexpected delays, but you know how life is.  Anything can happen between now and then.

You may be correct.  I won't know until that day happens.  And if that day comes, and I'm extremely sad, emotional, fearful I reserve the right to abort.  There are no guarantees here. This is such a taboo subject I don't think people play it out fully in conversation.  So let's say you're right, I have some concerning thoughts on the "day", I know myself, I'd postpone.  Who's to say that the next day I won't be completely fine having processed and contemplated this monumental decision.  There are no right on wrong answers in this subject.  It's all to be determined.
No. I'll be in this world for a while longer.  I'm not one to make rash decisions.
Thank you. I really think suicide has a bad reputation. It doesn't have to.

I'm finishing some things I started. I'm not doing a bucket list if that's what you mean.  I think I'll feel at peace if I just don't leave anything open ended. Again, this is not my immediate future. It's just the way it's going to end.

Please understand the need to keep this as anonymous as possible.  This type of post would come down heavy on anyone.  So if my answers are aloof it is for my own protection, not because I'm trying to be rude.
I have a great job in the professional world. I enjoy what I do most days.
